waiting.title: 42070 6x6 All Terrain Tow Truck: the rear differential turned round
waiting.what: A correction to the published file. The two rear axles are built as two modules whose differentials are mirror images: the booklet’s 1:1 pictures have the ring on the right of the casing in the first (step 123) and on the left in the second (step 147). The file draws both alike, so the one shaft that drives them turns the two rear axles against each other. The correction turns the rear differential’s casing half a turn, so its ring faces the other way, as in step 147.
waiting.effect: No score changes yet (3 work, 4 partly, 3 don’t): the drive (function 1) stays jammed for another reason, which the worker is tracing (the front wheels’ universal joints, read as rigid).
waiting.confidence: High. The worker looked at the booklet pages: the two 1:1 pictures are mirror images, drawn from the same side, and step 166 fits the second module at the rear.

waiting.title: A second worker for the faults of reading?
waiting.what: 347 functions are partly or not working. Only 41 of them fail for a reason in the solver. 303 fail by how we read the models or by a function list, and they stand on about 150 to 200 distinct faults: a part that nothing ties to its control (136 functions), a part held fixed (49), a loose part (47), a jammed control (40), a fixed control (25), a part forced to stay (6). One worker mends these. A second worker would be a third working session beside the solver owner and the worker.
waiting.effect: Rate now: 21 more working functions on 15 November and 13 on 16 November, from both sessions together. A second worker might add 5 to 10 a day, less than double, because this Mac is the limit: it runs one full check at a time and stood at a load of 30 on 12 cores today. Cost: the week's usage stood at 5% about 8 hours after its reset, with three sessions at work. At that pace a week of work day and night uses about the whole weekly limit, which you reached last week. A second worker adds roughly a third to that. Both figures are rough.
waiting.confidence: Claude's advice: not yet (to start one, reply "Second worker: yes"). First, with no new session: the solver owner takes faults of reading when its three solver tasks are done (it has only 41 functions of its own), and the worker takes first the few part types that recur over many sets (62274c01, 62821, 94925, 92695, 92696, 2851, 18947), where one fault in the library's connections may hold several functions. Claude asks again at mid-week with the usage and the rate measured.
